import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' and 'time' to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])
coffee_sales['time'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['time']).dt.time

# Create a bar chart of top 5 products by total sales
top_products = coffee_sales.groupby('product')['total'].sum().nlargest(5)
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=top_products.index, y=top_products.values)
plt.title('Top 5 Products by Total Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a pie chart of payment method distribution
payment_method_counts = coffee_sales['payment_method'].value_counts()
plt.figure(figsize=(8,8))
plt.pie(payment_method_counts, labels=payment_method_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%')
plt.title('Payment Method Distribution')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()

# Create a bar chart of average sales by age group
avg_sales_by_age = coffee_sales.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].mean()
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x=avg_sales_by_age.index, y=avg_sales_by_age.values)
plt.title('Average Sales by Age Group')
plt.xlabel('Age Group')
plt.ylabel('Average Sales ($)')
plt.xticks(rotation=90)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
plt.close()
